mechanism_narrative: A low level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) relative to historical norms indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% signals a tightening labor market, which typically precedes Federal Reserve rate hikes and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in periods when UNRATE < 3.5 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 255 and FEDFUNDS is below 2.0%, it signals persistent inflation without adequate monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: inflationary environment with inadequate policy response
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in triggered instances (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.1 percentage points over the past month signals an impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in late-cycle expansion periods when UNRATE rises > 0.1pp (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1500 thousand units signals a weakening in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in periods when HOUST < 1500 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 109.0 (index 2017=100) signals robust manufacturing output, which correlates with strong corporate profits and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods when INDPRO > 109.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales (RSAFS) below 520,000 million dollars over the past month signals weak consumer spending, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative in periods when RSAFS < 520000 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) over the past 5 months above 19200 billion dollars signals strong economic growth, which supports equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods when GDPC1 > 19200 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
